content:
**Poseidon Power Substation PX-01** is a location in The Forest region of Appalachia. 

This fenced-off power station has one shack containing some junk items. It is populated with several Scorched. Two Copper veins can be found next to the station. There is also a Power Box here that requires activating the Poseidon Energy Plant WV-06.

Potential Workshop Plan - On a cabinet in the substation shack.

The Poseidon Power Substation PX-01 appears in *Fallout 76*.
